Class ExplanationTree

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.ExplanationTree
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<ExplanationTree>
Direct Known Subclasses:
ExplanationTree.Branch, ExplanationTree.Root
public abstract class ExplanationTree extends Object implements Comparable<ExplanationTree>
An object for building explanations by prepending temporal edges to the start of the sequence.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware

    • getPlan

      public edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Plan getPlan()
      Returns the plan object represented by the sequence of actions that correspond to this explanation's sequence of temporal edges. This plan object will be unique to the story graph in which this explanation is created--that is, different explanations with the same plan will return the same plan object.
      Returns:
      the explanation's plan
